description: Bind this assistant to the user's Decionis Shield, one of two ways. (1) The six-character pairing code shown in the Shield app (AI spending allowance → Bind your own agent): pass it as code. (2) The user's email: pass email, and Shield emails them a 6-digit code; ask the user for it, then call again with email and emailCode. Ask the user; never guess a code. After pairing, shield.request_purchase and the other shield.* tools ask the user's own spending rules.

code.description: The pairing code from the Shield app.

displayName.description: How the Shield app should list this assistant (default: the client and this computer).

email.description: The user's Shield email, to be sent a sign-in code.

emailCode.description: The 6-digit code Shield emailed to the user.

name: shield.pair
title: Pair with the user's Shield
